Players Committee card image of [[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While at an Endor site, adds one [Light Side] icon here. During battle, may target one opponent's character present. Draw destiny. If destiny > ability, target is power -2 and its game text is canceled. Your scouts here are immune to Sniper, You Are Beaten, and attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/daughterofskywalker.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/30816d1eceffdd0a07a5af277fcbcbc9fc96f665 30816d1] (22 June 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
